lines.speaker: Ferren
lines.text: Do you know how long it takes to lock down a tower properly? And you just walk in.

lines.speaker: Ferren
lines.text: Fine. We do this the loud way. Everything in this building is louder than you think.

lines.speaker: Ferren
lines.text: Take the tower. It was never the point. The point is what it connects to.

lines.speaker: Ferren
lines.text: Tell whoever sent you: the locks were the easy part.

lines.speaker: Marlow
lines.text: Everything in this building is going somewhere. You, I think, are going to be a delay.

lines.speaker: Marlow
lines.text: I could have sold you a way out. I still could. The price just went up.

lines.speaker: Marlow
lines.text: Take the ledger. It is last month's. The current one left on last night's boat.

lines.speaker: Marlow
lines.text: You will see my boats again. You just will not see me on them.

lines.speaker: Tamsin

lines.speaker: Tamsin

lines.speaker: Corvin

lines.speaker: Ilsa
lines.text: The machines do not care who runs them. Remember that when you are the one running them.

lines.speaker: Aldous
lines.text: We welcome scrutiny. We always have. …No cameras now. Good. Then we can be honest.

lines.speaker: Aldous
lines.text: You have no idea what scrutiny costs. I do. I pay it every day.

lines.speaker: Aldous
lines.text: Print whatever you like. The institute will still be here tomorrow. That is what an institute is.

lines.speaker: Aldous
lines.text: You have won a room. The building is still standing.

lines.speaker: Mireille
lines.text: Oh, good, a fresh sample. I mean — a visitor. A visitor who fights. Even better.

lines.speaker: Mireille
lines.text: Fascinating. Your team holds together under pressure. Mine was not built to. Mine was built to survive.

lines.speaker: Mireille
lines.text: Take the warehouse. The cracks are still there. They do not close because you won a fight.

lines.speaker: Mireille
lines.text: Come back when you have seen the Rift properly. Then you will understand why I do this.

lines.speaker: Cassian
lines.text: You are behind schedule. Everyone in this network is behind schedule, lately. You most of all.

lines.speaker: Cassian
lines.text: You are behind schedule. Everyone in this network is behind schedule, lately. You most of all.

lines.speaker: Cassian
lines.text: This was not on the schedule. I will have to revise the schedule.

lines.speaker: Cassian
lines.text: …The network will hold without me. It held before me. But it will not hold as neatly. That is something, I suppose.

lines.speaker: Cassian
lines.text: Above me there are two people. One of them is a joke you have already met. The other is not a joke. Ask yourself which one you have actually been fighting.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: You tracked me here. Good. Most people track the Rift and lose it. You tracked me and found it.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: You tracked me here. Good. Most people track the Rift and lose it. You tracked me and found it.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: The Rift does not fight fair. Neither do I. That is the only honest thing about this work.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: Take the gate. Behind it there is no more network. There is a joke, and then there is the man who told it.

lines.speaker: Soren
lines.text: If you go through the Rift, do not expect it to make sense. It never has. Not for me either.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: You look rested enough to want a real test. I am Faye, and yes, I keep a team of my own.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: You look rested enough to want a real test. I am Faye, and yes, I keep a team of my own.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: This is only if you want it. No challenge, no pressure, and the bench stays open either way.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: Ready when you are. My team is small, but they train on this bench road every day.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: You are down to your last one... and my team still has fight left in them.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: Steady now. One more push from my side, and this friendly bout is mine.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: Well fought! You beat the nurse's team, fair and clean.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: That was a joy to watch. You earned this win, truly.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: Win or lose, the bench is still yours. Let me look after your whole team now, free as always.

lines.speaker: Nurse Faye
lines.text: Rest here whenever you need it. Healing is never the prize for beating me... it is just what I do.
